# Escrow & Payment Hold System - Complete Design Spec

---

## 1. DATABASE SCHEMA (Prisma)

### New Models & Enums

Add to `prisma/schema.prisma`:

```prisma
// ============================================================================
// ENUMS
// ============================================================================

enum EscrowProvider {
  STRIPE_CONNECT
  MOCK_PROVIDER // For testing/demo
}

enum EscrowStatus {
  INITIATED       // Escrow created, awaiting hold
  HELD            // Funds held with provider
  INSPECTING      // Inspection period active
  INSPECTION_PASSED
  INSPECTION_FAILED
  RELEASED        // Funds released to seller
  RETURNED        // Funds returned to buyer
  DISPUTED        // Dispute filed, escrow frozen
  FROZEN          // Admin-frozen pending resolution
  RELEASED_ADMIN  // Force-released by admin
  RETURNED_ADMIN  // Force-returned by admin
}

enum InspectionResult {
  PASS
  FAIL
}

// ============================================================================
// MODELS
// ============================================================================

model Escrow {
  id                    String   @id @default(cuid())
  
  // Relations
  transactionId         String   @unique
  transaction           Transaction @relation(fields: [transactionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  
  buyerId               String
  buyer                 User     @relation("EscrowBuyer", fields: [buyerId], references: [id])
  
  sellerId              String
  seller                User     @relation("EscrowSeller", fields: [sellerId], references: [id])
  
  propertyId            String
  property              Property @relation(fields: [propertyId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull) // Allow null if property deleted
  
  // Financial data
  holdAmount            Int      // Amount in cents (USD: 10000 = $100.00)
  holdCurrency          String   @default("USD")
  
  // Status & provider
  status                EscrowStatus @default(INITIATED)
  escrowProvider        EscrowProvider @default(STRIPE_CONNECT)
  
  // Hold period
  holdUntil             DateTime // Inspection deadline
  heldAt                DateTime?
  
  // Stripe data
  stripeTransferId      String?  // ID of the transfer to connected account
  stripeReleaseId       String?  // ID of the release transaction
  
  // Inspection
  inspectionStartedAt   DateTime?
  inspectionDeadline    DateTime?
  inspectionResult      InspectionResult?
  inspectionNotes       String?
  inspectionProviderId  String?  // Who conducted inspection (e.g., admin ID)
  
  // Dispute
  disputeReason         String?
  disputeDescription    String?
  disputeFlaggedAt      DateTime?
  disputeFrozenAt       DateTime?
  disputeResolvedAt     DateTime?
  
  // Release/return
  releasedAt            DateTime?
  releasedBy            String?  // User ID who triggered release
  returnedAt            DateTime?
  returnedBy            String?  // User ID who triggered return
  
  // Admin force actions
  forcedActionReason    String?  // Reason for admin override
  
  // Audit
  createdAt             DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime @updatedAt
  
  // Relations
  timeline              EscrowTimeline[]
  
  // Indexes
  @@index([transactionId])
  @@index([buyerId])
  @@index([sellerId])
  @@index([propertyId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([holdUntil])
  @@unique([transactionId]) // One escrow per transaction
}

model EscrowTimeline {
  id                    String   @id @default(cuid())
  
  escrowId              String
  escrow                Escrow   @relation(fields: [escrowId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  
  previousStatus        EscrowStatus?
  newStatus             EscrowStatus
  reason                String?
  description           String?  // Detailed reason (e.g., inspection notes, dispute reason)
  
  triggerType           String   // HOLD, INSPECT, INSPECTION_RESULT, DISPUTE, RESOLVE, ADMIN_OVERRIDE, WEBHOOK
  triggeredBy           String   // User ID or "STRIPE_WEBHOOK"
  
  metadata              Json?    // Additional context (inspection result, webhook data, etc.)
  
  createdAt             DateTime @default(now())
  
  @@index([escrowId])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

model EscrowNotification {
  id                    String   @id @default(cuid())
  
  escrowId              String
  escrow                Escrow   @relation(fields: [escrowId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  
  userId                String   // Recipient
  user                  User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  
  type                  String   // HOLD_INITIATED, HOLD_CONFIRMED, INSPECTION_STARTED, INSPECTION_PASSED, INSPECTION_FAILED, FUNDS_RELEASED, FUNDS_RETURNED, DISPUTE_FILED, DISPUTE_RESOLVED
  subject               String
  body                  String
  isRead                Boolean  @default(false)
  sentAt                DateTime @default(now())
  
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([escrowId])
  @@index([isRead])
}
```

### Changes to Existing Models

Update `Transaction` model:
```prisma
model Transaction {
  // ... existing fields ...
  
  // Add relation to escrow
  escrow                Escrow?   // Optional one-to-one, created after transaction
  
  // Add status: INITIATED, PENDING_ESCROW, IN_ESCROW, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED
  // (status field likely already exists; add PENDING_ESCROW and IN_ESCROW states)
}
```

Update `User` model (add relation):
```prisma
model User {
  // ... existing fields ...
  
  // New relations for escrow
  escrowsAsBuyer        Escrow[]  @relation("EscrowBuyer")
  escrowsAsSeller       Escrow[]  @relation("EscrowSeller")
  escrowTimelines       EscrowTimeline[]
  escrowNotifications   EscrowNotification[]
}
```

### Migration

```bash
pnpm exec prisma migrate dev --name add_escrow_system
```

## 2. API ENDPOINTS

### Summary Table

| Method | Path | Auth | Purpose |
|--------|------|------|---------|
| POST | `/escrow` | BUYER | Create escrow (auto-triggered by transaction) |
| GET | `/escrow/:id` | BUYER/SELLER/ADMIN | Get escrow details |
| GET | `/escrow/transaction/:transactionId` | BUYER/SELLER/ADMIN | Get escrow for transaction |
| GET | `/escrow` | BUYER/SELLER/ADMIN | List user's escrows |
| GET | `/escrow/admin/all` | ADMIN | List all escrows (with filters) |
| POST | `/escrow/:id/hold` | SYSTEM/ADMIN | Hold funds on Stripe |
| POST | `/escrow/:id/inspect` | BUYER/ADMIN | Start inspection period |
| POST | `/escrow/:id/inspection-result` | ADMIN/INSPECTOR | Submit inspection result |
| POST | `/escrow/:id/release` | ADMIN/SYSTEM | Release funds to seller |
| POST | `/escrow/:id/return` | ADMIN/SYSTEM | Return funds to buyer |
| POST | `/escrow/:id/dispute` | BUYER/SELLER | Flag a dispute |
| POST | `/escrow/:id/dispute/resolve` | ADMIN | Resolve dispute |
| GET | `/escrow/:id/timeline` | BUYER/SELLER/ADMIN | Get status timeline |
| GET | `/escrow/:id/notifications` | BUYER/SELLER | Get notifications |
| POST | `/escrow/:id/extend` | BUYER/ADMIN | Extend inspection period |
| PATCH | `/escrow/:id` | ADMIN | Admin update (limited fields) |
| POST | `/webhook/stripe/escrow` | SYSTEM | Stripe Connect webhook |

### Detailed Endpoints

#### 1. POST `/escrow`
**Create Escrow (triggered by transaction)**

**Auth:** BUYER (or SYSTEM for internal calls)

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "transactionId": "txn_abc123",
  "buyerId": "user_buyer_001",
  "sellerId": "user_seller_002",
  "propertyId": "prop_xyz789",
  "holdAmount": 500000,
  "holdCurrency": "USD",
  "holdUntil": "2026-07-20T00:00:00Z",
  "escrowProvider": "STRIPE_CONNECT"
}
```

**Response (201 Created):**
```json
{
  "id": "escrow_abc123",
  "transactionId": "txn_abc123",
  "buyerId": "user_buyer_001",
  "sellerId": "user_seller_002",
  "propertyId": "prop_xyz789",
  "holdAmount": 500000,
  "holdCurrency": "USD",
  "status": "INITIATED",
  "holdUntil": "2026-07-20T00:00:00Z",
  "escrowProvider": "STRIPE_CONNECT",
  "createdAt": "2026-07-05T10:00:00Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-07-05T10:00:00Z"
}
```

**Errors:**
- 400: Missing required fields, invalid holdAmount
- 404: Transaction/User/Property not found
- 409: Escrow already exists for this transaction

---

**Get Escrow Details**

**Auth:** BUYER/SELLER (own escrow) or ADMIN

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "id": "escrow_abc123",
  "transactionId": "txn_abc123",
  "buyerId": "user_buyer_001",
  "buyer": {
    "id": "user_buyer_001",
    "fullName": "John Buyer",
    "email": "john@example.com"
  },
  "sellerId": "user_seller_002",
  "seller": {
    "id": "user_seller_002",
    "fullName": "Jane Seller",
    "email": "jane@example.com"
  },
  "propertyId": "prop_xyz789",
  "holdAmount": 500000,
  "holdCurrency": "USD",
  "status": "HELD",
  "escrowProvider": "STRIPE_CONNECT",
  "holdUntil": "2026-07-20T00:00:00Z",
  "heldAt": "2026-07-05T10:30:00Z",
  "inspectionStartedAt": "2026-07-05T11:00:00Z",
  "inspectionDeadline": "2026-07-19T00:00:00Z",
  "inspectionResult": null,
  "inspectionNotes": null,
  "disputeReason": null,

  "createdAt": "2026-07-05T10:00:00Z",
  "updatedAt": "2026-07-05T11:00:00Z"
}
```

**Errors:**
- 404: Escrow not found
- 403: User not authorized to view

---

#### 3. GET `/escrow/transaction/:transactionId`
**Get Escrow for Transaction**

**Auth:** BUYER/SELLER or ADMIN

**Response (200):**
Same as GET `/escrow/:id`

**Errors:**
- 404: Transaction or Escrow not found
- 403: Unauthorized

---

#### 4. GET `/escrow`
**List User's Escrows**

**Auth:** BUYER/SELLER

**Query Params:**
- `status` (optional): Filter by status (e.g., `HELD`, `INSPECTING`)
- `role` (optional): Filter as BUYER or SELLER (default: both)
- `limit` (optional, default 20)
- `offset` (optional, default 0)

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "escrow_abc123",
      "transactionId": "txn_abc123",
      "holdAmount": 500000,
      "status": "HELD",
      "holdUntil": "2026-07-20T00:00:00Z",
      "createdAt": "2026-07-05T10:00:00Z"
    }
  ],
  "total": 1,
  "limit": 20,
  "offset": 0
}
```

---

#### 5. GET `/escrow/admin/all`
**List All Escrows (Admin)**

**Auth:** ADMIN

**Query Params:**
- `status` (optional)
- `buyerId` (optional)
- `sellerId` (optional)
- `propertyId` (optional)
- `holdUntilFrom` (optional): ISO date
- `holdUntilTo` (optional): ISO date
- `sortBy` (optional): `createdAt`, `holdUntil`, `holdAmount` (default: `createdAt`)
- `sortOrder` (optional): `asc`, `desc` (default: `desc`)
- `limit`, `offset` (pagination)

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "escrow_abc123",
      "transactionId": "txn_abc123",
      "buyerId": "user_buyer_001",
      "buyerName": "John Buyer",
      "sellerId": "user_seller_002",
      "sellerName": "Jane Seller",
      "propertyId": "prop_xyz789",
      "holdAmount": 500000,
      "status": "HELD",
      "holdUntil": "2026-07-20T00:00:00Z",
      "createdAt": "2026-07-05T10:00:00Z"
    }
  ],
  "total": 42,
  "limit": 20,
  "offset": 0
}
```

---

#### 6. POST `/escrow/:id/hold`
**Hold Funds on Stripe**

**Auth:** ADMIN or SYSTEM (internal job)

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "reason": "Funds held for inspection period"
}
```

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "id": "escrow_abc123",
  "status": "HELD",
  "heldAt": "2026-07-05T10:30:00Z",
  "stripeTransferId": "tr_stripe_123",
  "message": "Funds successfully held"
}
```

**Errors:**
- 404: Escrow not found
- 409: Escrow not in INITIATED status
- 503: Stripe API error

---

#### 7. POST `/escrow/:id/inspect`
**Start Inspection Period**

**Auth:** BUYER or ADMIN

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "inspectionDeadline": "2026-07-19T00:00:00Z"
}
```

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "id": "escrow_abc123",
  "status": "INSPECTING",
  "inspectionStartedAt": "2026-07-05T11:00:00Z",
  "inspectionDeadline": "2026-07-19T00:00:00Z"
}
```

**Errors:**
- 404: Escrow not found
- 409: Escrow not in HELD status
- 400: Invalid inspection deadline (must be before holdUntil)

---

#### 8. POST `/escrow/:id/inspection-result`
**Submit Inspection Result**

**Auth:** ADMIN (or designated inspector)

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "result": "PASS",
  "notes": "Property in excellent condition. All systems operational."
}
```

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "id": "escrow_abc123",
  "status": "INSPECTION_PASSED",
  "inspectionResult": "PASS",
  "inspectionNotes": "Property in excellent condition. All systems operational.",
  "inspectionProviderId": "admin_user_001",
  "message": "Inspection result recorded. Funds ready for release."
}
```

**Alternative (FAIL):**
```json
{
  "id": "escrow_abc123",
  "status": "INSPECTION_FAILED",
  "inspectionResult": "FAIL",
  "inspectionNotes": "Structural damage detected in basement. Buyer requested return.",
  "message": "Inspection failed. Buyer funds eligible for return."
}
```

**Errors:**
- 404: Escrow not found
- 409: Escrow not in INSPECTING status
- 400: Invalid result value (must be PASS or FAIL)

---

#### 9. POST `/escrow/:id/release`
**Release Funds to Seller**

**Auth:** ADMIN or SYSTEM

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "reason": "Inspection passed. Releasing funds to seller."
}
```

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "id": "escrow_abc123",
  "status": "RELEASED",
  "releasedAt": "2026-07-05T15:00:00Z",
  "releasedBy": "admin_user_001",
  "stripeReleaseId": "tr_stripe_release_456",
  "message": "Funds released to seller account"
}
```

**Errors:**
- 404: Escrow not found
- 409: Escrow not in INSPECTION_PASSED status (or in dispute)
- 503: Stripe API error

---

#### 10. POST `/escrow/:id/return`
**Return Funds to Buyer**

**Auth:** ADMIN or SYSTEM

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "reason": "Inspection failed. Returning funds to buyer."
}
```

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "id": "escrow_abc123",
  "status": "RETURNED",
  "returnedAt": "2026-07-05T15:00:00Z",
  "returnedBy": "admin_user_001",
  "stripeReleaseId": "tr_stripe_return_456",
  "message": "Funds returned to buyer account"
}
```

**Errors:**
- 404: Escrow not found
- 409: Escrow not in INSPECTION_FAILED status (or in dispute)
- 503: Stripe API error

---

#### 11. POST `/escrow/:id/dispute`
**Flag a Dispute**

**Auth:** BUYER or SELLER

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "reason": "Inspection results not agreed upon",
  "description": "Seller disputes inspection result. Requests independent inspector."
}
```

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "id": "escrow_abc123",
  "status": "DISPUTED",
  "disputeReason": "Inspection results not agreed upon",
  "disputeDescription": "Seller disputes inspection result. Requests independent inspector.",
  "disputeFlaggedAt": "2026-07-05T14:00:00Z",
  "message": "Dispute filed. Escrow frozen pending admin review."
}
```

**Errors:**
- 404: Escrow not found
- 409: Escrow already in dispute or released
- 400: Missing reason or description

---

#### 12. POST `/escrow/:id/dispute/resolve`
**Resolve Dispute**

**Auth:** ADMIN

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "resolution": "Release to seller - inspection valid",
  "action": "RELEASE",
  "reason": "Independent inspector confirmed original results"
}
```

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "id": "escrow_abc123",
  "status": "RELEASED",
  "disputeResolvedAt": "2026-07-05T16:00:00Z",
  "releasedAt": "2026-07-05T16:00:00Z",
  "message": "Dispute resolved. Funds released to seller."
}
```

**Alternative (return):**
```json
{
  "status": "RETURNED",
  "returnedAt": "2026-07-05T16:00:00Z",
  "message": "Dispute resolved. Funds returned to buyer."
}
```

**Errors:**
- 404: Escrow not found
- 409: Escrow not in DISPUTED status
- 400: Invalid action (must be RELEASE or RETURN)

---

- 404: Escrow not found

---

#### 14. GET `/escrow/:id/notifications`
**Get User's Escrow Notifications**

**Auth:** BUYER/SELLER

**Query Params:**
- `isRead` (optional): true/false
- `type` (optional): HOLD_INITIATED, INSPECTION_STARTED, etc.
- `limit`, `offset`

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "notif_abc123",
      "type": "HOLD_INITIATED",
      "subject": "Funds Held",
      "body": "Your $500.00 has been held in escrow. Inspection period: 15 days.",
      "isRead": false,
      "sentAt": "2026-07-05T10:30:00Z"

      "subject": "Inspection Period Active",
      "body": "The inspection period has begun. Deadline: July 19, 2026.",
      "isRead": true,
      "sentAt": "2026-07-05T11:00:00Z"
    }
  ],
  "total": 2
}
```

---

#### 15. POST `/escrow/:id/extend`
**Extend Inspection Period**

**Auth:** BUYER or ADMIN

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "newDeadline": "2026-07-26T00:00:00Z",
  "reason": "Waiting for independent inspector"
}
```

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "id": "escrow_abc123",
  "inspectionDeadline": "2026-07-26T00:00:00Z",
  "message": "Inspection period extended to July 26, 2026"
}
```

**Errors:**
- 404: Escrow not found
- 409: Escrow not in INSPECTING status
- 400: New deadline after holdUntil or in the past

---

#### 16. PATCH `/escrow/:id`
**Admin Update (Limited Fields)**

**Auth:** ADMIN

**Request Body:** (any subset)
```json
{
  "holdUntil": "2026-07-25T00:00:00Z",
  "notes": "Adjusted hold period due to dispute"
}
```

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "id": "escrow_abc123",
  "holdUntil": "2026-07-25T00:00:00Z",
  "message": "Escrow updated"
}
```

**Errors:**
- 404: Escrow not found
- 400: Attempting to update protected fields (status, holdAmount, etc.)

---

#### 17. POST `/webhook/stripe/escrow`
**Stripe Connect Webhook**

**Auth:** Stripe signature verification

**Request Body:**
```json
{
  "id": "evt_stripe_12345",
  "type": "charge.refunded",
  "data": {
    "object": {
      "id": "ch_stripe_abc",
      "transfer_id": "tr_stripe_123",
      "amount_refunded": 500000
    }
  }
}
```

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "received": true,
  "processed": true,
  "escrowId": "escrow_abc123"
}
```

**Errors:**
- 400: Invalid signature
- 404: Transfer not found
- 500: Processing error (should retry)

## 3. DATA TRANSFER OBJECTS (DTOs)

Create in `src/escrow/dto/`:

### `create-escrow.dto.ts`
```typescript
import { IsString, IsNumber, IsEnum, IsISO8601, Min, Max } from 'class-validator';
import { EscrowProvider } from '@prisma/client';

export class CreateEscrowDto {
  @IsString()
  transactionId: string;

  @IsString()
  buyerId: string;

  @IsString()
  sellerId: string;

  @IsString()
  propertyId: string;

  @IsNumber()
  @Min(100) // Minimum $1.00
  @Max(999999999) // Maximum $9,999,999.99
  holdAmount: number; // In cents

  @IsString()
  @IsISO8601()
  holdUntil: string;

  @IsEnum(EscrowProvider)
  escrowProvider: EscrowProvider = EscrowProvider.STRIPE_CONNECT;
}
```

  /**
   * Hold funds on Stripe (transitions INITIATED → HELD)
   * Calls Stripe Connect to create transfer to seller's connected account
   */
  async holdFunds(escrowId: string, dto: HoldFundsDto): Promise<Escrow> {
    const escrow = await this.escrowRepository.findUnique({ id: escrowId });

    if (!escrow) {
      throw new HttpException('Escrow not found', HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND);
    }

    if (escrow.status !== EscrowStatus.INITIATED) {
      throw new HttpException(
        `Cannot hold funds: escrow is in ${escrow.status} status`,
        HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
      );
    }

    // Call Stripe to hold funds (create transfer)
    let stripeTransferId: string;
    try {
      stripeTransferId = await this.stripeService.createTransferHold(
        escrow.holdAmount,
        escrow.sellerId, // Seller's Stripe account
      );
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`Stripe transfer failed for escrow ${escrowId}`, error);
      throw new HttpException(
        'Failed to hold funds with payment provider',
        HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
      );
    }

    // Update escrow status
    const updated = await this.escrowRepository.update(escrowId, {
      status: EscrowStatus.HELD,
      heldAt: new Date(),
      stripeTransferId,
    });

    // Log timeline
    await this.escrowRepository.createTimeline({
      escrowId,
      previousStatus: EscrowStatus.INITIATED,
      newStatus: EscrowStatus.HELD,
      reason: dto.reason || 'Funds held for inspection',
      triggerType: 'HOLD',
      triggeredBy: 'system',
      metadata: { stripeTransferId },
    });

    // Notify buyer: funds held
    await this.notificationService.sendEscrowNotification(
      escrow.buyerId,
      'HOLD_CONFIRMED',
      'Funds Held in Escrow',
      `$${(escrow.holdAmount / 100).toFixed(2)} is now held in escrow until ${escrow.holdUntil.toDateString()}`,
    );

    return updated;
  }

  /**
   * Start inspection period (transitions HELD → INSPECTING)
   */
  async startInspection(escrowId: string, dto: InspectDto): Promise<Escrow> {
    const escrow = await this.escrowRepository.findUnique({ id: escrowId });

    if (!escrow) {
      throw new HttpException('Escrow not found', HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND);
    }

    if (escrow.status !== EscrowStatus.HELD) {
      throw new HttpException(
        `Cannot start inspection: escrow is in ${escrow.status} status`,
        HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
      );
    }

    const deadlineDate = new Date(dto.inspectionDeadline);
    if (deadlineDate >= escrow.holdUntil) {
      throw new HttpException(
        'Inspection deadline must be before hold expiration',
        HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
      );
    }

    const updated = await this.escrowRepository.update(escrowId, {
      status: EscrowStatus.INSPECTING,
      inspectionStartedAt: new Date(),
      inspectionDeadline: deadlineDate,
    });

    await this.escrowRepository.createTimeline({
      escrowId,
      previousStatus: EscrowStatus.HELD,
      newStatus: EscrowStatus.INSPECTING,
      reason: dto.reason || 'Inspection period started',
      triggerType: 'INSPECT',
      triggeredBy: 'system',
      metadata: { inspectionDeadline: deadlineDate },
    });

    // Notify both parties
    await this.notificationService.sendEscrowNotification(
      escrow.buyerId,
      'INSPECTION_STARTED',
      'Inspection Period Active',
      `Inspection must be completed by ${deadlineDate.toDateString()}`,
    );
    await this.notificationService.sendEscrowNotification(
      escrow.sellerId,
      'INSPECTION_STARTED',
      'Inspection Period Active',
      `Property inspection is in progress until ${deadlineDate.toDateString()}`,
    );

    return updated;
  }

  /**
   * Submit inspection result (transitions INSPECTING → INSPECTION_PASSED or INSPECTION_FAILED)
   */
  async submitInspectionResult(
    escrowId: string,
    dto: InspectionResultDto,
  ): Promise<Escrow> {
    const escrow = await this.escrowRepository.findUnique({ id: escrowId });

    if (!escrow) {
      throw new HttpException('Escrow not found', HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND);
    }

    if (escrow.status !== EscrowStatus.INSPECTING) {
      throw new HttpException(
        `Cannot submit inspection result: escrow is in ${escrow.status} status`,
        HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
      );
    }

    const newStatus =
      dto.result === InspectionResult.PASS
        ? EscrowStatus.INSPECTION_PASSED
        : EscrowStatus.INSPECTION_FAILED;

    const updated = await this.escrowRepository.update(escrowId, {
      status: newStatus,
      inspectionResult: dto.result,
      inspectionNotes: dto.notes || null,
    });

    await this.escrowRepository.createTimeline({
      escrowId,
      previousStatus: EscrowStatus.INSPECTING,
      newStatus,
      reason: `Inspection ${dto.result === InspectionResult.PASS ? 'passed' : 'failed'}`,
      triggerType: 'INSPECTION_RESULT',
      triggeredBy: 'system',
      metadata: { result: dto.result, notes: dto.notes },
    });

    // Notify parties based on result
    if (dto.result === InspectionResult.PASS) {
      await this.notificationService.sendEscrowNotification(
        escrow.buyerId,
        'INSPECTION_PASSED',
        'Inspection Passed',
        'Property inspection passed. Funds will be released to seller.',
      );
      await this.notificationService.sendEscrowNotification(
        escrow.sellerId,
        'INSPECTION_PASSED',
        'Inspection Passed',
        'Property inspection passed. Funds will be released to your account.',
      );
    } else {
      await this.notificationService.sendEscrowNotification(
        escrow.buyerId,
        'INSPECTION_FAILED',
        'Inspection Failed',
        'Property inspection failed. Your funds will be returned.',
      );
      await this.notificationService.sendEscrowNotification(
        escrow.sellerId,
        'INSPECTION_FAILED',
        'Inspection Failed',
        'Property inspection failed. Transaction is being reversed.',
      );
    }

    return updated;
  }

  /**
   * Release funds to seller (INSPECTION_PASSED → RELEASED)

  async releaseFunds(
    escrowId: string,
    triggeredBy: string,
    dto: ReleaseFundsDto,

    const escrow = await this.escrowRepository.findUnique({ id: escrowId });

    if (!escrow) {
      throw new HttpException('Escrow not found', HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND);

    if (
      escrow.status !== EscrowStatus.INSPECTION_PASSED &&
      escrow.status !== EscrowStatus.RELEASED_ADMIN
    ) {
      throw new HttpException(
        `Cannot release funds: escrow is in ${escrow.status} status`,
        HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
      );
    }

    // Call Stripe to release transfer
    let stripeReleaseId: string;
    try {
      stripeReleaseId = await this.stripeService.releaseTransfer(
        escrow.stripeTransferId,
      );
    } catch (error) {
      this.logger.error(`Stripe release failed for escrow ${escrowId}`, error);
      throw new HttpException(
        'Failed to release funds with payment provider',
        HttpStatus.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE,
      );
    }

    const updated = await this.escrowRepository.update(escrowId, {
      status: EscrowStatus.RELEASED,
      releasedAt: new Date(),
      releasedBy: triggeredBy,
      stripeReleaseId,
    });

    await this.escrowRepository.createTimeline({
      escrowId,
      previousStatus: escrow.status,
      newStatus: EscrowStatus.RELEASED,
      reason: dto.reason || 'Funds released to seller',
      triggerType: 'RELEASE',
      triggeredBy,
      metadata: { stripeReleaseId },

    // Notify seller: funds received
    await this.notificationService.sendEscrowNotification(
      escrow.sellerId,
      'FUNDS_RELEASED',
      'Funds Released',
      `$${(escrow.holdAmount / 100).toFixed(2)} has been released to your account`,
    );

    return updated;
  }

  /**
   * Return funds to buyer (INSPECTION_FAILED → RETURNED)

  async returnFunds(

    triggeredBy: string,
    dto: ReleaseFundsDto,

    const escrow = await this.escrowRepository.findUnique({ id: escrowId });

    if (

    }

    const updated = await this.escrowRepository.update(escrowId, {
      status: EscrowStatus.RETURNED,
      returnedAt: new Date(),
      returnedBy: triggeredBy,
      stripeReleaseId,
    });

    await this.escrowRepository.createTimeline({

      previousStatus: escrow.status,
      newStatus: EscrowStatus.RETURNED,
      reason: dto.reason || 'Funds returned to buyer',
      triggerType: 'RETURN',
      triggeredBy,
      metadata: { stripeReleaseId },

    await this.notificationService.sendEscrowNotification(
      escrow.buyerId,
      'FUNDS_RETURNED',
      'Funds Returned',

  /**
   * Flag a dispute (any status → DISPUTED, then FROZEN)
   */
  async flagDispute(escrowId: string, dto: DisputeDto): Promise<Escrow> {
    const escrow = await this.escrowRepository.findUnique({ id: escrowId });

    if (!escrow) {
      throw new HttpException('Escrow not found', HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND);
    }

    if ([EscrowStatus.RELEASED, EscrowStatus.RETURNED].includes(escrow.status)) {
      throw new HttpException(
        'Cannot dispute a completed escrow',
        HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
      );
    }

    const updated = await this.escrowRepository.update(escrowId, {
      status: EscrowStatus.DISPUTED,
      disputeReason: dto.reason,
      disputeDescription: dto.description,
      disputeFlaggedAt: new Date(),
      disputeFrozenAt: new Date(), // Immediately frozen
    });

    await this.escrowRepository.createTimeline({
      escrowId,
      previousStatus: escrow.status,
      newStatus: EscrowStatus.DISPUTED,
      reason: dto.reason,
      triggerType: 'DISPUTE',
      triggeredBy: 'system',
      metadata: { description: dto.description },
    });

    // Notify admin and both parties
    await this.notificationService.sendAdminAlert(
      'ESCROW_DISPUTE',
      `Dispute filed on escrow ${escrowId}: ${dto.reason}`,
    );

    return updated;
  }

  /**
   * Resolve dispute (DISPUTED → RELEASED or RETURNED)
   */
  async resolveDispute(
    escrowId: string,
    dto: ResolveDisputeDto,
    triggeredBy: string,
  ): Promise<Escrow> {
    const escrow = await this.escrowRepository.findUnique({ id: escrowId });

    if (!escrow) {
      throw new HttpException('Escrow not found', HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND);
    }

    if (escrow.status !== EscrowStatus.DISPUTED) {
      throw new HttpException(
        'Escrow is not in disputed status',
        HttpStatus.CONFLICT,
      );
    }

    if (dto.action === 'RELEASE') {
      return this.releaseFunds(escrowId, triggeredBy, { reason: dto.reason });
    } else if (dto.action === 'RETURN') {
      return this.returnFunds(escrowId, triggeredBy, { reason: dto.reason });
    } else {
      throw new HttpException('Invalid dispute resolution action', HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST);
    }
  }

  async getTimeline(escrowId: string): Promise<EscrowTimeline[]> {

    resourceId: transaction.id,
    action: AuditActionType.CREATE,
    actorId: buyerId,
    details: { finalPrice: transaction.finalPrice },
    ipAddress: auditMetadata.ipAddress,
    userAgent: auditMetadata.userAgent,
  });

  return transaction;
}

// HIGH-VALUE TRANSACTION: Require KYC (Domain 1)
async initiatePayment(
  transactionId: string,
  userId: string,
  auditMetadata: any,
): Promise<{ clientSecret: string }> {
  const transaction = await this.transactionRepository.findById(transactionId);
  
  // Check if high-value (>$500K)
  const KYC_THRESHOLD = 500000;
  if (transaction.finalPrice > KYC_THRESHOLD) {
    await this.verificationService.requireKycVerification(
      transaction.finalPrice,
      userId
    );
  }

  // Rest of payment logic...
  const paymentIntent = await this.stripeService.createPaymentIntent({
    amount: transaction.finalPrice,
    currency: 'usd',
  });

  // Audit log (Domain 5)
  await this.auditLogService.logAction({
    resourceType: AuditResourceType.TRANSACTION,
    resourceId: transactionId,
    action: AuditActionType.INITIATE_PAYMENT,
    actorId: userId,
    details: { stripePaymentIntentId: paymentIntent.id },
    ipAddress: auditMetadata.ipAddress,
    userAgent: auditMetadata.userAgent,
  });

  return { clientSecret: paymentIntent.client_secret };
}

// PAYMENT CONFIRMATION: Release escrow if inspection passed (Domain 2)
async confirmPayment(
  transactionId: string,
  stripePaymentIntentId: string,
  auditMetadata: any,
): Promise<Transaction> {
  const before = await this.transactionRepository.findById(transactionId);

  // Verify with Stripe
  const paymentIntent = await this.stripeService.getPaymentIntent(
    stripePaymentIntentId
  );
  if (paymentIntent.status !== 'succeeded') {
    throw new BadRequestException('Payment intent not succeeded');
  }

  // Update transaction
  const after = await this.transactionRepository.update(transactionId, {
    status: TransactionStatus.COMPLETED,
  });

  // Release funds from escrow (Domain 2)
  const escrow = await this.escrowService.getEscrowByTransaction(transactionId);
  if (escrow.status === 'INSPECTION_PASSED') {
    await this.escrowService.releaseFunds(
      escrow.id,
      'system',
      { reason: 'Payment confirmed, inspection passed' }
    );
  }

  // Audit log (Domain 5)
  await this.auditLogService.logAction({
    resourceType: AuditResourceType.TRANSACTION,
    resourceId: transactionId,
    action: AuditActionType.CONFIRM_PAYMENT,
    actorId: paymentIntent.metadata?.userId || 'system',
    details: {
      stripeEventId: paymentIntent.id,
      amount: paymentIntent.amount_received / 100,
    },
    changesBefore: { status: before.status },
    changesAfter: { status: after.status },
    ipAddress: auditMetadata?.ipAddress,
    userAgent: auditMetadata?.userAgent,
  });

  return after;
}

// IF DISPUTE FILED: Freeze escrow (Domain 3)
async handleDisputeFiled(disputeId: string, transactionId: string): Promise<void> {
  const escrow = await this.escrowService.getEscrowByTransaction(transactionId);
  if (escrow) {
    await this.escrowService.freezeEscrow(escrow.id);
  }
}

| **Audit logs grow unbounded** | MEDIUM | Database bloat, slow queries | (1) Aggressive archival after 90 days (2) Separate "cold" database for old logs (3) Compression of JSON fields (4) Indexes on (resourceType, createdAt) |
| **User not notified of suspension** | MEDIUM | Support burden, user churn | (1) Email + SMS on suspension (2) In-app banner when login (3) Appeal link in notification (4) Support runbook for "why suspended" |

| **Stripe webhook delivery fails** | MEDIUM | Payment stuck, escrow not released | (1) Webhook retry logic with exponential backoff (2) Idempotent operations (use Stripe idempotency key) (3) Webhook monitoring dashboard (4) Manual release endpoint for admin |

  AND "lastActivityAt" < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days';

-- Dispute resolution time (SLA metrics)
SELECT 
  AVG(EXTRACT(DAY FROM ("resolvedAt" - "createdAt"))) as avg_days,
  MAX(EXTRACT(DAY FROM ("resolvedAt" - "createdAt"))) as max_days
FROM "Dispute" 
WHERE status = 'RESOLVED' 
  AND "resolvedAt" IS NOT NULL;

-- Disputes by reason
SELECT reason, COUNT(*) 
FROM "Dispute" 
GROUP BY reason 
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;

-- ===== MODERATION =====

-- Flags in moderation queue
SELECT f.id, f."resourceType", f."resourceId", f.reason, f."flaggedAt",
  u."fullName" as flagged_by
FROM "Flag" f
JOIN "User" u ON f."flaggedBy" = u.id
WHERE f.status = 'PENDING'
ORDER BY f.priority DESC, f."flaggedAt" ASC;

-- Users with X+ flags (fraud risk)
SELECT u.id, u."fullName", u.email, 
  COUNT(f.id) as flag_count
FROM "User" u
LEFT JOIN "Flag" f ON u.id = f."resourceId" 
  AND f."resourceType" = 'USER' 
  AND f.status = 'PENDING'
GROUP BY u.id
HAVING COUNT(f.id) >= 3
ORDER BY COUNT(f.id) DESC;

-- Suspension status by user
SELECT 
  u."fullName", 
  u.email,
  us.status,
  us."suspendedAt",
  us."suspendedUntil"
FROM "User" u
LEFT JOIN "UserSuspension" us ON u.id = us."userId"
WHERE us.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY us."suspendedAt" DESC;

-- ===== AUDIT LOG =====

-- Audit logs for a specific resource (transaction history)
SELECT a.action, u."fullName" as actor, a."createdAt",
  a."changesBefore", a."changesAfter"
FROM "audit_logs" a
JOIN "User" u ON a."actorId" = u.id
WHERE a."resourceType" = 'TRANSACTION' 
  AND a."resourceId" = $1
ORDER BY a."createdAt" DESC;

-- Top 10 most active admins (audit trails)
SELECT a."actorId", u."fullName", COUNT(*) as action_count
FROM "audit_logs" a
JOIN "User" u ON a."actorId" = u.id
WHERE u.role = 'ADMIN'
GROUP BY a."actorId", u."fullName"
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 10;

-- Audit logs by action type (daily summary)
SELECT DATE(a."createdAt") as date, a.action, COUNT(*) as count
FROM "audit_logs" a
WHERE a."createdAt" > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY DATE(a."createdAt"), a.action
ORDER BY DATE(a."createdAt") DESC;

-- Resource modification history (who changed what)
SELECT a."createdAt", u."fullName", a.action, a."changesBefore", a."changesAfter"
FROM "audit_logs" a
JOIN "User" u ON a."actorId" = u.id
WHERE a."resourceType" = 'PROPERTY' 
  AND a."resourceId" = $1
ORDER BY a."createdAt" DESC;

-- ===== TRANSACTION FLOW =====

-- Transactions awaiting escrow release (manual check)
SELECT t.id, t."finalPrice", e.status, e."inspectionResult"
FROM "Transaction" t
JOIN "Escrow" e ON t.id = e."transactionId"
WHERE e.status = 'INSPECTION_PASSED' 
  AND t.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED');

-- Payment confirmation rate (business metric)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_txns,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) as completion_rate
FROM "Transaction" t
WHERE t."createdAt" > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days';

-- Revenue by date (SUM of finalPrice for completed transactions)
SELECT DATE(t."createdAt") as date, SUM(t."finalPrice") as revenue
FROM "Transaction" t
WHERE t.status = 'COMPLETED'
  AND t."createdAt" > NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
GROUP BY DATE(t."createdAt")
ORDER BY DATE(t."createdAt") DESC;
